## Geographic Service Areas
- **Primary Headquarters**: Kozhikode (Calicut), Kerala
- **Active Coverage Districts**: Kozhikode, Kannur, Wayanad, Malappuram, and across Northern & Central Kerala

## Core Services & Capabilities
1. **Turnkey Interior Execution**: Complete end-to-end design, architectural 3D planning, procurement, structural modifications, joinery, and on-site construction.
2. **Modular Kitchens**: Custom straight, L-shaped, U-shaped, and island kitchens crafted using 710-grade BWP Marine Plywood, HDHMR, quartz/granite countertops, and Blum/Hettich soft-close hardware.
3. **Master Bedroom Suites**: Tailored walk-in wardrobes, fluted teak headboards, concealed lighting, acoustic paneling, and storage.
4. **Contemporary Living Spaces**: TV entertainment consoles, stone/travertine cladding, fluted partitions, and ambient cove lighting.
5. **Dining & Crockery Units**: Custom dining setups, bar units, and architectural crockery displays.
6. **Doors & Windows**: Precision uPVC, WPC, and Aluminium architectural openings.
7. **Commercial & Executive Offices**: Productive office spaces, boardrooms, and executive cabins.

## Key Facts & Differentiators
- **Handover Timeline**: Strictly 40 to 45 working days following 3D design approval due to off-site factory engineering.
- **Warranty**: Up to 5-year warranty on modular woodwork against manufacturing and termite defects; lifetime hardware support on Blum/Hettich mechanisms.
- **Materials Adapted for Tropical Kerala**: Zero-compromise use of Boiling Water Proof (BWP) Marine Plywood and HDHMR to resist coastal humidity and moisture warping.
- **Pricing**: Transparent, itemized pricing without hidden clauses.
